design.control: the parent V14 training frame for each interface
design.transverse_pair: move the full Ag sublattice by ±0.15 A along xy tangent cross(r_X-r_Ag,z_hat), holding the marked-pair longitudinal projection constant
design.framework_pair: move only the selected framework contact atom by ±0.04 A along its historical V15 force-residual direction; Ag fixed
design.species_contact_screen: candidate element-pair minima cannot be >0.05 A below the smallest current split/official input geometry for that formula; empirical screen, not universal bond threshold
design.dedup: all train/valid/test split geometries, official V13-V16 input manifests, newly proposed withheld geometry inputs and earlier B label-free proposals; intended parent-control near hits are reported, not hidden
